_note: Curated (T2c/T7). W (Silver Bolts) deals TRUE damage as a % of the target's MAX HP (auto-picker wrongly tagged Magic). T7: modeled as a %HP hit whose fraction resolves LIVE per rank from the BIN DataValue 'MaxHealthRatio' (VayneSilveredBolts) = [0.05,0.06,0.07,0.08,0.09,0.10,0.11] (a per-rank array, indexed by ability rank) — no baked number, so it is correct at every rank and tracks the patch. Silver Bolts procs on every 3rd hit; modeled as one proc (count 1) placed where the 3rd hit lands. Q (Tumble) empowers the next auto with bonus physical damage. E (Condemn) is physical. DOCUMENTED LIMITATION (loop 350, no data change): wiki confirms Silver Bolts also has a flat DamageFloor minimum (50/65/80/95/110 at ranks 1-5) that applies whenever the %maxHP calc would be lower -- true formula is max(%maxHP, DamageFloor). The BIN exposes DamageFloor as a plain DataValue with no calc/max-of-two-parts node, and this schema has no greater-of-two-values operator, so only the %maxHP term is modeled. This underestimates W damage only against very-low-max-HP targets (early levels / anomalous cases) where the floor would exceed the % value -- a rare, honest, documented gap, not a fabricated fix (same class as Rell E PercentHealthDamageCap).
